extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Common insects and body parts — insects have 3 body parts (head, thorax, abdomen), 6 legs, 2 antennae, and often wings. Common insects: ant, butterfly, bee, mosquito, fly, grasshopper. Spiders are NOT insects (8 legs, 2 body parts). (2) Life cycle of a butterfly — Egg → Caterpillar (larva, eats leaves) → Chrysalis/Cocoon (pupa, transforms inside) → Butterfly (adult, flies and lays eggs). This is called metamorphosis. (3) Social insects — ants and bees live in large groups/colonies. Ants: ant hill, queen lays eggs, workers collect food and build. Bees: beehive with honeycomb, queen lays eggs, workers make honey from nectar, drones mate. Division of labour. (4) Harmful insects and remedies — mosquitoes spread malaria and dengue (use mosquito nets and repellent), flies spread germs (keep food covered), cockroaches contaminate food (keep kitchen clean), termites damage wood (use anti-termite treatment). Helpful insects: bees pollinate flowers and make honey, butterflies pollinate, ladybirds eat pests. Misconceptions: 'spiders are insects' (spiders have 8 legs and 2 body parts, insects have 6 legs and 3 body parts), 'caterpillar and butterfly are different animals' (caterpillar is the baby form of butterfly), 'all insects are harmful' (bees, butterflies, ladybirds are helpful), 'bees make honey from flowers directly' (bees collect nectar from flowers and turn it into honey in the hive). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function InsectsGame), NOT export default. Export interface InsectsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
